instruction: I'd like to change the VLC volume slider colors to a red theme instead of the default. Can you customize it to use reddish colors?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing VLC volume slider colors to a red theme. The evaluator checks if qt-slider-colours setting contains primarily reddish RGB values (high R, low G/B) in the VLC configuration file. Similar to original task but with different color requirement.
metadata.verification: Created custom metric check_qt_slider_colours__b8889bac that checks for reddish colors (R > 150 AND R > G+50 AND R > B+50). Similar logic to original blackish check.
